description: Parse any user-agent string into browser, version, OS, device type and engine — live-parses your own UA or any string you paste.

faqs.a: Detection order matters: Edge and Opera both contain 'Chrome' in their UA, so the parser checks Edg/OPR tokens before Chrome, and CriOS/FxiOS for iOS variants.
No. User-agent strings can be spoofed or frozen (Chrome's UA reduction), so treat the result as a hint, not proof.
Yes — paste any UA string into the box and the parse updates live.
faqs.q: Can I parse a different UA string?

faqs.a: Yes, everything runs locally in your browser.

howto: Your own user-agent string is parsed automatically on load.
Paste any other UA string to parse it instead.
Read the browser, version, OS, device and engine breakdown.
title: User Agent Parser
